- Quantization profiles: running 4-bit QAT candidate + per-layer fallback for critical heads. Trade-off: ~12-18% latency improvement, model quality OK on 80% of test cases; flagged top-10 prompts for manual review.
- Routing policy: host majority traffic to hosted-api for rapid iteration; failover to Dedicated variant with cheaper quantized model when capacity/budget constraints detected.
